items.name: research-question
items.title: Research Question
items.description: Turn a rough thesis topic into a defensible research question by interviewing the student one question at a time: narrowing scope, naming the gap, fixing the unit of analysis, and testing the question for answerability, novelty, and fit to a master's timeline. Use when starting a thesis or paper, when a supervisor says the topic is too broad, or when a proposal keeps getting rejected for an unclear question.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
